text:
marta-rios: Follow-up thread for Meridian outage postmortem. Short recap: flapping VPC peering + on-prem ACL race caused partial tenant isolation on Dedicated nodes. Theres a lingering reconciliation bug where we transiently drop KV sync and mark nodes unreachable. Need owners/timelines for fixes and a durable mitigation for customers on private wiring.

devon-lam: Thanks Marta. Can we enumerate concrete action items and narrow owners? Ill handle infra-facing stuff but want to avoid duplicate work with platform team.

priya-shah: I'll coordinate with Meridians on-prem ops. Actionable asks: exact ACL rule set they applied, firewall logs around the incident window, and their preferred maintenance window.

marta-rios: Heres what I propose:
1) immediate mitigation: holdback peering changes + route pin for active sessions (owner: devon-lam)
2) durable fix: stateful reconciliation + ordered apply to avoid ACL race (owner: tom-bell)
3) on-prem validation checklist + signed confirmation (owner: priya-shah)
4) monitoring: new metric and alert for "peering_reconcile_failures" and KV sync error rate (owner: devon-lam)
5) customer-facing postmortem + SLA note (owner: marta-rios)

devon-lam: Assigning me #1 and #4. ETA for mitigation: 36 hours for a config rollout to Dedicated and a 72-hour canary. Will open INC-2201-1 for the mitigation.

priya-shah: Assigning me #3. I can have the checklist and initial email to Meridian in 24 hours. Will ask for firewall dump and maintenance slots.

tom-bell: Assigning #2. Plan: implement ordered apply with a per-peer lock and a short ephemeral sync window so ACLs and routes settle before traffic shifts. ETA: prototype in 5 business days, integration tests in 8.

ops-bot: Linked incident: INC-2201. Add PR references to INC-2201 when opening code changes.

marta-rios: For monitoring, devon add a Grafana alert + PagerDuty runbook. Priya, please ensure Meridian will allow health-check port 9100 and enable ephemeral port range 31000-32000 for KV.

devon-lam: Noted. Monitoring plan:
- metric: peering_reconcile_failures (counter)
- metric: kv_sync_errors_during_peering (rate)
- alert: >3 failures in 5m -> P2 page to oncall + owner tag devon-lam
I'll add a dashboard panel and a runbook snippet.

priya-shah: Meridian asked about rollback behavior. They prefer a no-evict mode during reconciliation. We can implement read-only marking for nodes during rollback to preserve warmed caches.

tom-bell: Read-only marking makes sense. For ordered apply, pseudocode: 
```
acquire_peer_lock(peer_id)
apply_acl_updates()
wait_for_acl_ack(timeout)
apply_route_updates()
release_peer_lock(peer_id)
```
If ACL ack fails, revert routes and mark nodes read-only until sync is healthy. Will include unit + e2e with firewall simulator returning 403/timeout.

marta-rios: Timelines we have so far:
- mitigation roll (config route pin + holdback): owner devon-lam, ETA 36h (by ${ETA_MITIGATE})
- ordered apply prototype: owner tom-bell, ETA 5 business days
- on-prem checklist & customer signoff: owner priya-shah, ETA 2 business days
- monitoring + runbook: owner devon-lam, ETA 3 business days
- customer postmortem draft: owner marta-rios, ETA 4 business days
Please flag if these need tightening.

devon-lam: Ill open INC-2201-1 and a config PR for immediate route pin. Will tag @tom-bell where relevant.

priya-shah: Ive requested Meridians firewall logs and asked for a Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC maintenance window. They replied tentatively OK. Will confirm in 24h.

tom-bell: I'll start the integration harness: simulate ACL deny and ensure rollback keeps nodes read-only not evicted. Test cases: 403 during ACL apply, delayed ACL ack, and flapping ACL acceptance.

marta-rios: Also add a recurring analytics job to scan historical incidents for "peering flaps correlated with KV errors" so we can quantify recurrence. Assign owner?

devon-lam: I can own the analytics scan after mitigation. ETA: 7 business days for initial report.

ops-bot: Reminder: Weekly incident review Tue 10:00 UTC; this incident added to agenda.

priya-shah: Checkpoints for owners:
- T+1 (tomorrow): mitigation config merged to canary
- T+3: priya confirms maintenance OK and uploads firewall logs
- T+5: ordered apply prototype + unit tests merged to staging
- T+9: full rollout + post-deploy verification job success

marta-rios: Great. Ill draft the customer-facing postmortem and link the technical PRs. If anything slips, call it out here so we can adjust the timeline. :handshake:
